[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Agents tab agent data decks and cards[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The Agents tab replaces its metadata panel and its Files and LLM [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Calls panels with one deck-panel type. It shows one or two panels, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stacked top and bottom or side by side, and each panel shows an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent data deck (Main, Files or Tools) made of agent data cards. A [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]deck renders all of its cards on one page when they fit a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]configurable threshold and one card per page otherwise. Keys cycle [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]cards (Ctrl+J/K) and decks (Ctrl+N/P), split and unsplit panels (\ [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and |), move focus (Ctrl+F), collapse the node panel (Ctrl+S) and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]zoom a deck in place (Z). The p view picker, the Z zoom modal and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the legacy panel modes are deleted, and glossary strands describe [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the new vocabulary.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
